item.title: November 2026 Festivals Around Korea: Gangwon, Chungcheong, Jeolla, Gyeongsang and Jeju
item.description: Festivals outside Seoul for November 2026: Busan Fireworks Festival, Gumi Ramyeon Festival, kimjang festivals in Goesan and Pyeongchang, Goheung Yuja Festival, the yellowtail festival in Moseulpo, Jeju Citrus Expo and the last chrysanthemum festivals, with dates, venues, fees and transport.
